reuse: Same conditional overdamped, identical-junction resistively loaded circuit equations. New sweep/validation code derives and tests a numerically stable coordinate formulation of those equations. No Navier-Stokes code is used in this separate circuit extension.
physical_assumptions: The supplied diagram is interpreted as two identical RSJ junctions with individual resistance r, a shared resistive load R and ideal DC bias. No device-specific component values or measurements were supplied.
new_prediction_claim: None. This pilot separates numerical, initial-state, settling and finite-observation effects in established circuit dynamics.
